The business of politics is nasty, ugly, and at times humiliating.

There’s something very attractive about the sport of politics, but it’s not for everyone.

One day you’re a rockstar.

Wish her nothing but the best in her next move.

Most men spend their entire lives either trying to become their father or trying not to.

A father’s impact is there, whether good or bad.

No amount of money will make the wrong people happy.  

You can NEVER win over the wrong people.
